reasoning: Primary filings show a company whose ~$560M market cap (2.425 x ~231M diluted shares, src 2) is mostly cash: ~$488.5M liquidity at 30-Jun-2026 (src 1,2), est. ~$460M by Oct-2026 after the SAIQ PIPE and burn, i.e. ~$2.0/share, leaving ~ $100M EV for a business guided to $27-36M revenue in 2026 (src 1) at ~48% gross margin but a $32M H1 operating loss. That cash backing compresses the left tail: a fall below ~$1.2 requires both heavy cash leakage and a deep discount, so P(<1.21) ~8%. Against that, the burn (~$45M/yr) plus continued strategic deployments (target $200M, >$60M done) erode per-share cash by ~$0.45 over 12 months, certifications have slipped twice in six weeks (src 3 vs 4), and governance (WISeKey control, related-party SPACs, PFIC risk; src 8,11) justifies a discount, so my blended fair value ($2.08) sits slightly below spot. The right tail is real: quantum names re-rate violently and the stock traded at $8.71 within the year, so I keep ~20% bull weight and ~10% at >=$4.85. The recent tape is calm (10 weeks in $2.15-2.63, src 14), so I use an effective ~70-80% annual vol with a cash-floored left tail and a fat right tail; median ~$2.25, P(>=spot) ~45%. Research limited to filings, one call summary and price data; no analyst targets (Twelve Data plan restriction) and no option data by design.
